tagline: Powering modern life and economic progress
hero_kpi_rationale: Master KPI of the upstream segment, hydrocarbon production is the primary driver of revenues and margins for integrated oil majors. A robust growth trajectory supports capital discipline and shareholder returns.

kpis.name: Hydrocarbon production
kpis.explanation: Daily quantity of oil and gas produced, converted to barrels of oil equivalent.
kpis.description: Total production reached 3.7 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in 2025, up 2% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Production growth in a context of capex discipline

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual spending to explore, develop fields and maintain refineries.
kpis.description: Capex totaled $29.0 billion in 2025 ($28,997 million according to Business Profile), up 13% from $25.6 billion in 2024, reflecting an acceleration of investments in high-return projects.

kpis.name: Free cash flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after deducting current investments.
kpis.description: FCF reached approximately $30.2 billion in 2025, supported by robust operational cash generation despite increased capex.
kpis.signal: FCF growth driven by solid cash generation

kpis.name: Return on capital employed
kpis.explanation: Profitability of invested capital, calculated as net income divided by average capital employed.
kpis.description: Return on capital employed stood at 9.4% in 2025 (9.3% according to Business Profile), down 3.4 percentage points from 12.7% in 2024, reflecting margin compression in a less favorable pricing environment.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net result after income taxes.
kpis.description: Net income totaled $28.8 billion in 2025, down 14% from $33.7 billion in 2024, reflecting margin compression in the Energy Products and Chemical Products segments.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €448.98 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €43.54 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Cash and equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of €10.68 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.03 in latest year

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $17.231 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 59.7% in latest year

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $332.238 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income annually, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years from 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $28.844 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Low-carbon investments
kpis.explanation: Investments in low-carbon opportunities including carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and ammonia, low-emission fuels, and lithium.
kpis.description: Low-carbon capex reached approximately $1.2 billion in 2025, up 20%, reflecting the pursuit of opportunities in carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and ammonia, low-emission fuels, Proxxima resin systems, carbon materials, low-carbon data centers and lithium.

risks.title: Commodity prices

risks.title: Climate change and energy transition
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the Climate Change and Energy Transition section (ITEM 1A), with high intensity, as climate policies and energy transition can have a significant impact on the company's results.
